detailZh: 詹姆斯·沃尔斯：威廉姆斯领队承认车队因成功而得意忘形，但表示2026赛季F1的挣扎只是“小挫折”
观看或收听《The Fast and the Curious》最新一期节目，听威廉姆斯领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯谈论车队2026年的困境、他为何有信心已经走出低谷，以及他希望F1成本上限规则做出的调整
在《The Fast and the Curious》播客中，威廉姆斯车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯与Christian Hewgil对谈，回应了关于其职位压力的评论。
威廉姆斯车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯承认车队上赛季因成功而“得意忘形”，但他坚称2026赛季的低迷只是“小挫折”。
沃尔斯在2023年初从梅赛德斯加盟后接管了威廉姆斯车队，并在车队于2025年制造商积分榜上获得第五名时似乎产生了巨大的积极影响，这是他们自2017年以来的最佳成绩。
然而，这项运动历史上最大的规则变革——同时引入了新的动力单元和底盘——导致威廉姆斯车队退步，让车手卡洛斯·塞恩斯和亚历克斯·阿尔本感到非常沮丧。

我认为经历这些是件好事，因为我们已经在车队后方做出了相当大的改变，在我看来，我们必须经历这些才能迈出下一步。
我认为去年我们有些得意忘形了，这恰恰说明当情况没有太大变化时，我们有能力造出一辆还算不错的赛车。但规则变化总会让你暴露无遗。
威廉姆斯车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯在《Fast and the Curious》播客中与克里斯蒂安·休吉尔交谈时表示，成本上限正在拉大车队之间的差距，并导致F1不再是一项“健康的运动”。
尽管威廉姆斯的挣扎引发了外界对沃尔斯职位稳定性的猜测，但这位47岁的领队坚称自己并未感到压力。
沃尔斯说：“当我签约加入时，我与董事会达成了一项协议，那就是当我们开始全力推进时，我们会发现一些糟糕的事情。这不是一个我们可以走出去、完全预测我们在不同阶段会处于什么位置的行业。”
“但我会奉献我的心灵、灵魂和每一天的每一小时，团队也会如此，一旦发现问题就全力解决。但我请求作为回报，在这方面能得到背后的支持。”
威廉姆斯的卡洛斯·塞恩斯在阿塞拜疆大奖赛练习赛中刹车起火后被迫进入维修区。
“我必须说，董事会一直非常出色，真的，以至于我记得在冬天，一个相当糟糕的冬天，我每周工作七天，每天工作16、18个小时，那很艰难。我打电话给他们所有人。而一切只是‘我们在这里支持你。我们能帮什么忙？’仅此而已。”
“这不是一个人们会掉以轻心的环境。他们知道这将是一项艰巨的挑战。我早就知道这会是一项艰巨的挑战。我向全世界保证，我们所做的一切在方向上都是正确的，都是为了我们的未来。”

detailEn: James Vowles: Williams boss admits team got carried away with success but says 2026 F1 season struggles are only 'a blip'

Joining Christian Hewgil on the Fast and the Curious podcast, Williams Team Principal James Vowles responds to comments on the pressure of his position.
Williams team principal James Vowles has admitted his squad "got carried away" with their success last season but insists a disappointing 2026 campaign is merely "a blip".

Vowles took charge of Williams after joining from Mercedes at the start of 2023 and appeared to be having a hugely positive impact when the team finished fifth in the 2025 constructors' standings, which was their best finish since 2017.

However, the biggest regulation change in the sport's history, which saw the introduction of both new power units and chassis, has seen Williams regress, leaving drivers Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon hugely frustrated.

They are ninth of the 11 teams with three rounds of the 2026 season remaining and have scored just 12 points, which compares poorly to a final total of 137 a year earlier.
Alex Albon found himself in the wall at Turn Five, bringing out the safety car at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Appearing on the latest episode of The Fast and the Curious podcast, Vowles said: "There's going to be blips in the pathway. This is what I consider a blip, unfortunately.
"And I think it's a good thing we went through it because we've made some pretty enormous changes in the backside of the team, which we had to go through, in my opinion, to make the next steps.

"And I think we got carried away a little bit with ourselves last year, demonstrating that actually when things aren't changing too much, we have the ability to produce a half decent car. But regulation changes will always expose you."

Joining Christian Hewgil on the Fast and the Curious podcast, Williams Team Principal James Vowles says that the cost cap is making the gap between teams bigger and is leading to F1 not being a 'healthy sport'.
Despite Williams' struggles leading to speculation over the security of Vowles' job, the 47-year-old insists that he is not feeling the pressure.

"When I signed up to this, I had an agreement with the board that we're going to find some horrible things when we start pushing ourselves," Vowles said. "It's not a business where we can go out there and completely predict where we're going to be in different phases.
"But I will dedicate my heart, soul and every hour of my day, as will the team into fixing it when we find it. But I ask in return that there's a support behind us in that way.

I called to see all of them. And all it was, was just really a 'we're here behind you. How can we help?' That was it.

"It is not an environment where people are taking this light-heartedly. They know that this is going to be a difficult challenge. I knew it was going to be a difficult challenge. My assurance to the world is everything we are doing is directionally correct for our future."

items.originalTitle: George Russell loses 90 points to Max Verstappen in five GPs in F1 2026 runner-up battle
items.summaryEn: In the 2026 fight for the drivers' championship runner-up spot, Russell has lost 90 points to Verstappen over the last five grands prix, and Mercedes is considering giving Russell its full support to secure a 1-2 in the standings.
detailZh: 拉塞尔在2026赛季F1亚军争夺中五站内被维斯塔潘追回90分
在还剩最多三站的情况下，拉塞尔在与维斯塔潘的副冠军之争中处于下风
马克斯·维斯塔潘（红牛车队）、乔治·拉塞尔（梅赛德斯）
梅赛德斯正考虑给予乔治·拉塞尔“全部力量”，以在经历一段噩梦般的状态后确保车手积分榜前二。
2026赛季还剩三站——假设卡塔尔和阿布扎比大奖赛按计划进行——在基米·安东内利于墨西哥锁定个人首个F1世界冠军后，至少有五名车手仍在争夺年度亚军：马克斯·维斯塔潘（279分）、拉塞尔（262分）、刘易斯·汉密尔顿（261分）、夏尔·勒克莱尔（249分）和兰多·诺里斯（246分）。
拉塞尔在过去五场大奖赛中状态灾难性下滑，仅得26分，而维斯塔潘同期得到116分。这位英国车手在马来西亚遭遇动力单元故障，在新加坡冲刺赛中撞车退赛并接受引擎罚退，在奥斯汀经历了一场令人费解的低迷比赛，在墨西哥遇到部署问题，在圣保罗表现良好时于维修区出口打转。
“我还没有考虑车手世界冠军，”车队领队托托·沃尔夫在巴西大奖赛后表示，梅赛德斯在那里锁定了制造商世界冠军。
“我们绝对希望他拿到最高分，并希望他能获得第二名，我们需要考虑为此做些什么，但有可能我们会全力以赴。”
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
梅赛德斯在英特拉格斯的辉煌时刻是其F1生涯中的第九次，也是与拉塞尔合作的第二次；拉塞尔在萨基尔大奖赛顶替汉密尔顿出战，为银箭2020年的总冠军贡献了三分。
当被问及如何在2027年前为拉塞尔找到鼓舞时，沃尔夫表示：“你知道，今天这是拉塞尔的总冠军，这是车队总冠军，他是车队的一部分——我真的很高兴他能珍惜这一刻，因为我们欠他的。”
“你知道，他有时处境非常艰难，昨天就是一个很好的例子。他在湿地排位赛中绝对占据主导，本应轻松拿下杆位，但最后一圈夺走了他的杆位。”
“现在我们还剩三场比赛。就像我说的，我们会全力以赴，而他一定会恢复的，对此我毫不怀疑，明年他就能做到。所有最顶尖的运动员都经历过困难时期，而这将成为他持续成长的一部分。”
detailEn: George Russell loses 90 points to Max Verstappen in five GPs in F1 2026 runner-up battle
Russell is losing out to Verstappen in the race to be vice-champion, with up to three rounds remaining
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes
Mercedes is considering giving George Russell “all the force” to secure a 1-2 in the drivers’ championship after a nightmare run of form.

Three rounds remain in the 2026 season - assuming the Qatar and Abu Dhabi grands prix proceed as planned - with no fewer than five drivers in contention for the runner-up spot: Max Verstappen (279 points), Russell (262), Lewis Hamilton (261), Charles Leclerc (249) and Lando Norris (246) after Kimi Antonelli clinched his maiden Formula 1 world title in Mexico.

Russell has been on a catastrophic streak over the last five grands prix, scoring just 26 points to Verstappen’s 116. The Briton suffered a power unit failure in Malaysia, crashed out of the sprint and took an engine penalty in Singapore, had a bafflingly poor Austin race, encountered a deployment issue in Mexico and spun at pit exit when running well in Sao Paulo.
“I haven't thought about the drivers' championship yet,” team principal Toto Wolff commented following the Brazilian Grand Prix, where Mercedes wrapped up the constructors' championship.

“We absolutely want him to score the maximum and hopefully finish second, and we need to think about what we're going to do about it, but it could be a possibility that we're giving it all the force.”
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes

Mercedes' triumphant moment at Interlagos was its ninth in F1 and second with Russell, who contributed three points to the Silver Arrows’ 2020 crown as he stood in for Hamilton at the Sakhir Grand Prix.

Asked how to find encouragement for Russell ahead of 2027, Wolff said: “You know, it's George's championship today, it's the constructors’ championship, and he's part of the team – and I'm really happy that he can cherish this moment, because we owe it to him.

“You know, he had it so tough at times, and yesterday was a good example. He was absolutely dominating the wet qualifying, he should have been on pole easily, and then this last lap took away his pole position.

“Now we have three races to go. We're going to, like I said, go full blast, and he will recover, I have no doubt about that for next year. All the very best sportspeople have gone through difficult periods, and that's going to be part of his continued development.”

汉密尔顿告诉车迷，他对巴西大奖赛的结果感到“崩溃”；这场比赛他以从队尾发车的精彩追赶开局，却在最后几圈打滑。
这位法拉利车手在周日于英特拉格斯赛道获得第九名后，于周一在Instagram上分享了他的想法。
汉密尔顿因引擎罚退不得不从第20位发车，但他在使用半雨胎的早期阶段提升了11个位置，随后他的后轮开始衰退。他推动马拉内罗车队换上干胎，并成为第一位做出切换的车手。
比赛在第62圈雨水回归时发生转折。这位英国车手在干胎上多坚持了一圈，并在到达维修区前打滑，最终在他的第400场大奖赛中获得第九名，落后一圈。
“对昨天的比赛感到极度沮丧，尤其是它的结束方式。开局非常好，但我们在轮胎和严重的转向过度上挣扎，”这位七届冠军发帖写道。
“在那种条件下，比赛变得极其困难。我尽了最大努力去推进，但本周末我们就是缺乏速度。我们会努力弄清楚原因，并在下一场比赛中重新奋起反击。”
“整个周末车队都在赛车上付出了巨大努力，我对此心怀感激。最终，这并不是我们想要交付的比赛。尤其是对这群观众而言。”
“巴西，感谢你一如既往的能量与支持。这个地方在我心中占据着如此特殊的位置，你们给予我的爱，我原样奉还。祝贺梅赛德斯赢得制造商冠军，也祝贺他们整体上不可思议的一年。实至名归。”
汉密尔顿还向他本人和法拉利的车迷补充了一段话，解释他并没有把他们的支持视为理所当然。
“感谢每一位支持我们的人，无论是艰难的日子还是美好的时光，谢谢你们一直与我们同在，”他总结道。“我感受到了这份支持，我并不会将其视为理所当然。”
汉密尔顿目前在车手积分榜上排名第四，本赛季还剩三站比赛。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton sends message to Ferrari fans after 'devastating' Brazil GP
Lewis Hamilton shared a message to fans after disappointing Brazilian GP
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

Lewis Hamilton has told fans he is "devastated" by the outcome of his Brazilian Grand Prix, which began with an impressive charge from the back of the grid and finished with a spin in the closing laps.
The Ferrari driver shared his thoughts on Instagram on Monday after finishing ninth at Interlagos on Sunday.

Hamilton had to start from 20th on the grid after an engine penalty, but climbed 11 places in the early running on intermediate tyres before his rears began to fade. He pushed the Maranello outfit to change to slicks and was the first driver to make the switch.

The race turned when the rain returned on lap 62. The Briton stayed out for one more lap on slicks and spun just before reaching the pits, eventually finishing ninth and a lap down in his 400th grand prix.
"Devastated by yesterday’s race, especially with how it ended. It started so well, but we struggled with the tyres and massive oversteer," the seven-time champion posted.

"In those conditions, it made things incredibly difficult. I pushed as hard as I could, but we just didn’t have the pace this weekend. We’ll work to understand why and come back fighting at the next race.
"The team worked so hard on the car all weekend and I’m grateful for every bit of that effort. Ultimately, this isn’t the race we wanted to deliver. Especially to this crowd.

"Brasil, thank you always for the energy and support. This place holds such a special place in my heart, the love you give to me I send right back to you. Well done to Mercedes for winning the constructors' championship and the incredible year they’ve had overall. Truly deserved."
Hamilton added a message to his and Ferrari's fans, explaining that he does not take their support for granted.
"To everyone supporting us, thank you for sticking with us through the difficult days as well as the good ones," he concluded. "I feel that support, and I don’t take it for granted."
Hamilton currently sits fourth in the drivers' standings with three rounds remaining in the season.

detailZh: 艾尔顿·塞纳罕见的本田NSX在拍卖中以创纪录的六位数成交价打破估价
曾由三届一级方程式冠军艾尔顿·塞纳使用过的本田NSX为该车型创下了新的拍卖纪录
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
由三届一级方程式冠军艾尔顿·塞纳使用过的本田NSX为该车型创下了拍卖纪录。
这辆车的预估售价在拍卖前在50万至80万英镑之间，于10月31日在伦敦的RM Sotheby's拍卖会上以87.125万英镑的价格成交。拍卖还包括一辆2002年的法拉利550 Maranello、一辆由Scaglietti设计的1964年法拉利250 GT/L Berlinetta Lusso以及一辆1903年的克莱蒙特AC4R 12/16 HP后置引擎敞篷车。
在塞纳加入迈凯轮-本田F1车队期间，作为与塞纳的一项协议，本田公司允许他使用三辆NSX作为个人车辆，其中两辆是黑色的。第三辆，底盘号为T000233，是红色配黑色车顶和黑色内饰，于1991年在葡萄牙注册为SX-25-59。它一直停在里斯本，并在塞纳访问该国时被带去，他在Quinta do Lago购买了房产。
塞纳在1994年圣马力诺大奖赛中的不幸去世后，这辆NSX被卖给了罗伯特·麦卡甘，并搬到了英国。这位英国人在2024年卖掉了NSX，当时的新主人将其送回日本，但后来又将其运回英国进行这次最新的拍卖。
这辆传奇车型配备了一台六缸三升发动机，产生271马力，可在5.8秒内从0加速到60英里/小时，最高时速可达165英里。
塞纳参与了本田NSX的测试，并且著名地在这辆赛车在铃鹿赛道上进行了驾驶，这是日本大奖赛的举办地。
Sholto Gilbertson，RM Sotheby's UK的销售总监表示："塞纳的遗产远不止他的三个世界冠军头衔。他的风格和优雅是永恒的，当你想到塞纳——不拘小节地穿着牛仔裤、白色袜子以及棕色乐福鞋，坐在一辆道路赛车的驾驶座上——你会想到NSX。这是拥有一个真正的体育和文化历史的宝贵机会。"
detailEn: Ayrton Senna's rare Honda NSX smashes auction estimate with record six-figure sale
A Honda NSX once used by three-time Formula 1 champion Ayrton Senna has set a new auction record for the model
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
A Honda NSX used by three-time Formula 1 champion Ayrton Senna has set an auction record for the model.

The car, which had been estimated to sell for between £500,000 and £800,000 prior to the auction, sold for £871,250 at RM Sotheby's in London on 31 October. The auction also included a 2002 Ferrari 550 Maranello, a 1964 Ferrari 250 GT/L Berlinetta Lusso by Scaglietti and a 1903 Clement AC4R 12/16 HP Rear-Entrance Tonneau.

As part of an agreement with Senna during his time with the McLaren-Honda Formula 1 team, Honda gave him access to three NSXs for personal use, two of which were black. The third, chassis T000233, was Formula Red with a black roof and black leather interior, and was registered in Portugal as SX-25-59 in 1991. It remained in Lisbon and was brought to the Brazilian driver on his visits to the country, where he had bought a property at Quinta do Lago.

After Senna's tragic passing at the 1994 San Marino Grand Prix, the NSX was sold to Robert McKagan and moved to the UK. The Briton later sold the NSX in 2024, when its new owners returned it to Japan, but it has since been moved back to the UK for this latest sale.
The legendary car boasts a six-cylinder three-litre engine producing 271bhp, can accelerate from 0-60mph in 5.8 seconds and reach a top speed of 165mph.
Senna was involved in testing the Honda NSX and famously drove it at the Suzuka Circuit, home of the Japanese Grand Prix.

Sholto Gilbertson, RM Sotheby's UK director of sales, said: "Senna’s legacy runs far deeper than his three world championships. His style and elegance are everlasting, and when you think of Senna—nonchalantly dressed in jeans, white socks and brown loafers behind the wheel of a road car—you think of an NSX. This is a wonderful opportunity to own a genuine piece of sporting and cultural history."

detailZh: 小红牛的风向正重新摆向无可争议的利亚姆·劳森
在有报道称利亚姆·劳森将留在小红牛之际，这位新西兰车手似乎将因其顽强表现获得回报
当工作保障稀缺时，F1车手只有一个解决办法：好到让人无法忽视你。
说来容易做来难，但这似乎正是利亚姆·劳森在近期美国三连赛中为未来而战时铭记于心的。作为小红牛升至车队积分榜第五的重要一员——这将是这支英意车队的历史最佳成绩——劳森在奥斯汀获得第九，随后在墨西哥和巴西连续两站获得第七。

在挑战者尼古拉·措洛夫于墨西哥站第一节练习赛表现强劲地完成首秀，以及劳森不幸与红牛中坚马克斯·维斯塔潘发生摩擦之后，种种迹象如今表明，形势的钟摆已重新摆回有利于劳森的一侧，预计下周拉斯维加斯大奖赛周末将作出决定。据《The Race》报道（Motorsport.com 认为该报道准确），劳森现在最终确定留队，而措洛夫将于 2027 年作为储备车手加入。消息人士表示，最终决定已接近敲定，但尚未签署。
为自己的未来而驾驶让劳森精疲力竭，即便对这位 24 岁的车手来说这并非新情况。自从 2023 年他作为受伤的丹尼尔·里卡多的替补到来以来，劳森实际上一直在为自己的席位而战，先是作为旁观者，随后作为里卡多的全职替代者，而在下一个比赛周末之后几乎没有任何工作保障。
在过去的三连赛期间，这一切达到了顶点，小红牛以及更广泛的红牛组织一直在推迟在劳森和措洛夫之间作出最终决定。
如果小红牛是一支独立车队，那么保留劳森和阿维德·林德布拉德的决定本会毫无悬念。新秀林德布拉德仍被视为未来红牛车队的潜在人选。而尽管那扇窗口对劳森来说似乎已经开启又关闭，他仍已累积 89 分，是前四名车队之外得分最高的车手。
不过，由于小红牛车队（小红牛）的任务是为红牛车队培养年轻车手，据了解，红牛奥地利母公司对F2领跑者措洛夫（Tsolov）的前景尤为兴奋。然而，留下劳森的决定未必会与小红牛车队的目标相悖，因为另一辆车上拥有如此可靠的基准，对衡量林德布拉德今年的表现同样有帮助。与此同时，19岁的措洛夫仍将从一整年的储备车手经历中受益，其中包括更多第一节自由练习（FP1）、私人测试和模拟器工作。
奥地利方面还明确要求小红牛车队在身份认同和竞技表现两方面都要自立自强，因此像车队领队艾伦·珀曼（Alan Permane）这样一位彻头彻尾的F1老将，才会热衷于最大化赛车性能并选择留下劳森。
周五在圣保罗被追问这一话题时，珀曼表示：“主要因素一如既往是节奏和速度。这是我们最先关注的东西。但我们不只是一支为参赛而存在的车队。我们在这里是为了培养年轻人才，所以必须关注这一点。而这并不一定意味着我们只是不断地让年轻人才轮流坐进赛车。我们或许也需要一些经验来衡衡量这些人才。”
对利亚姆·劳森来说，这个凶险的巴西周末是他最出色的表现之一。
最清楚地暗示各利益相关方之间的意见分歧才是真正阻碍决定的人，正是劳森本人。“我觉得艾伦一直非常支持我，我非常感激这一点，”他说。“今年我很享受与他以及车队紧密合作。显然，这是一个庞大的组织，所以……”
佩尔曼最近刚签下一份新合同，任期至2031年，担任小红牛（小红牛）车队领队兼联席首席执行官，因此他的意见显然很有分量。而且按理说，佩尔曼在做出承诺之前，一直希望获得关于自己在决策中份额的某些保证。
“艾伦做得非常出色，车队取得的进步直接反映了他的经验、投入和竞争心态，”佩尔曼的老板、红牛企业项目与投资首席执行官奥利弗·明茨拉夫表示。“他带来了清晰、沉稳，以及对F1所需表现的深刻理解，同时营造了一个让人们能够持续发挥最佳水平的环境。”
与此同时，劳森和车队的粉丝们一直在车队的社交媒体渠道上大量留言，敦促其与这位新西兰人续约。“我感谢所有支持。过去几周我看到了。说实话，看到这些真的很暖心。
小红牛车队（小红牛）将以第五名完赛，创下其车队历史最佳制造商锦标赛成绩。
在最关键的时刻，巴西站或许是劳森迄今最出色的一个周末。在险恶的条件下，劳森在排位赛中取得第五名，由于乔治·拉塞尔和夏尔·勒克莱尔被罚退，他正赛从第三位发车。
雨中，他在起步时超越迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯升至第二，但当车手们让半雨胎重新进入正确的工作窗口后，他又回落到自然位置。劳森奋力拼搏，在赛道上以第八名完赛，在勒克莱尔因最后几圈强行超越被处罚后，他升至第七名。
佩尔曼显然理解过去几周和几个月对这位2026赛季F1表现突出者之一有多艰难，但表示车队已接近目标。
“我明白这对我们的车手来说很令人沮丧，”他补充道。“我明白这对其他所有人来说也很令人沮丧，但我们希望把事情做对，而且我们一定会做对。我相信，当我们在未来几周内宣布时，大家都会满意的……”
detailEn: How the Racing Bulls pendulum is swinging back towards undeniable Liam Lawson
Amid reports of Liam Lawson staying put at Racing Bulls, the New Zealander appears set to be rewarded for his tenacity
When job security is in short supply, there's one solution for an F1 driver. Be so good they can't ignore you.

That's easier said than done, but it certainly seems to be what Liam Lawson has taken to heart as he battled for his future over the recent American triple-header. Having been an integral part of Racing Bulls' rise to fifth in the constructors' championship, which will be the Anglo-Italian team's best-ever result, Lawson took ninth in Austin before bagging a pair of seventh-place finishes in Mexico and Brazil.

Following his challenger Nikola Tsolov's strong FP1 debut in Mexico, and Lawson's unfortunate run-in with Red Bull's stalwart Max Verstappen, signs are now pointing towards the pendulum having swung back in Lawson's favour with a decision expected over the Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend next week. A report from The Race, which Motorsport.com understands is accurate,  says Lawson is now set to stay put after all with Tsolov coming on board as a reserve in 2027.  Sources have indicated a final decision is close but not signed off yet.

Driving for his future has been exhausting for Lawson, even if it's not a new situation for the 24-year-old. Ever since he arrived as a deputy for the injured Daniel Ricciardo in 2023, Lawson has effectively been fighting for his seat, first from the sidelines and then as Ricciardo's full-time replacement with little to no job security beyond the next race weekend.
It all came to a head over the past triple-header as Racing Bulls and the wider Red Bull organisation kept delaying a final call between Lawson and Tsolov.

If Racing Bulls had been a standalone team, the decision to retain Lawson and Arvid Lindblad would have been a no-brainer. Rookie Lindblad is still seen as potential Red Bull Racing material in the future. And while that window appears to have come and gone for Lawson, he has amassed 89 points as the highest point scorer outside the top four teams.

With Racing Bulls tasked to train young drivers for Red Bull Racing though, it is understood Red Bull's Austrian parent company is particularly excited by F2 frontrunner Tsolov's promise. However, a decision to keep Lawson wouldn't necessarily work against Racing Bull's objective, as having such a solid benchmark in the other car has been useful to gauge Lindblad's performances this year too. Meanwhile, 19-year-old Tsolov would still benefit from a full year as a reserve driver, which includes more FP1s, private testing and simulator work.

Racing Bulls has also been explicitly asked by Austria to stand on its own feet both in terms of identity and performance, so that's why a dyed-in-the-wool F1 veteran like team principal Alan Permane would have been keen to maximise performance and stick with Lawson.

"The main factors are, as always, pace and speed. That's the very first thing we look for," Permane said when grilled on the topic on Friday in Sao Paulo. "But we're not just a team that exists solely to compete. We are here to bring young talent through, so we have to keep an eye on that. And that doesn't necessarily mean that we just keep churning young talent through the car. We need to maybe have some experience as well to measure that talent."
A treacherous Brazil weekend was one of Liam Lawson's finest.

The clearest hint that a difference in opinion between the various stakeholders is what has really been holding up the decision came from Lawson himself. "I feel like Alan's been extremely supportive to me and I appreciate that a lot," he said. "I've enjoyed working closely with him and with the team this year. Obviously, it's a big organisation so..."

Permane recently inked a fresh deal until 2031 as Racing Bulls team principal and co-CEO, so it's obvious that his opinion carries plenty of weight. And it would stand to reason that  Permane has wanted some assurances about his share in the decision-making before committing.

"Alan is doing a tremendous job, and the progress the team has made is a direct reflection of his experience, commitment and competitive mindset," said Permane's boss Oliver Mintzlaff, CEO Corporate Projects and Investments Red Bull. "He brings clarity, composure, and a deep understanding of what it takes to perform in Formula 1, while creating an environment where people can consistently deliver at their best."

Meanwhile, fans of Lawson and the team have been flooding the squad's social media channels urging it to re-sign the Kiwi. "I appreciate all the support. I've seen it over the last few weeks. It's honestly really nice to see.
Racing Bulls is set for its strongest ever constructors' championship result in fifth place.

When it mattered the most, Brazil was perhaps Lawson's finest weekend yet. In treacherous conditions, Lawson took fifth on the grid, starting from third after grid penalties for George Russell and Charles Leclerc.

In the rain, he picked off McLaren's Lando Norris for second at the start, only to fall back to his natural position once drivers got their intermediate tyres back in the right operating window. Lawson battled to claim eighth on the road, being promoted to seventh after Leclerc was penalised for barging his way past in the closing laps.
Permane was obviously appreciative of how tough the past few weeks and months have been on one of F1 2026's standout performers, but said the team is nearly there.

"I realise it's frustrating for our drivers," he added. "I realise it's frustrating for everyone else, but we want to get it right, and we will get it right. I'm sure when we announce it in the coming weeks, everyone will be happy..."

detailZh: 维斯塔潘如何在巴西站以第二名击败红牛自家的模拟工具
车队领队洛朗·梅基斯承认，红牛的模拟工具并未考虑过从第21位发车取得第二名的可能性
连续第三年，维斯塔潘在F1圣保罗大奖赛上奉献了一场令人印象深刻的追击战。这位荷兰车手2024年从第17位发车夺冠，去年从维修区起步追至第三名，而这一次他从第21位一路追至第二名。
据维斯塔潘所说，他在上坡发车格上的起步并不顺利，不过他主动揽责，称自己离合器操作有误，导致反应时间偏慢。但此后，这位荷兰车手迅速推进。在使用半雨胎的第一段比赛中，他就已经把领奖台位置纳入视野，这比红牛依据自家模拟所预期的要早得多。
洛朗·梅基斯在赛后于红牛接待区表示：“一如既往，我认为世界上没有任何模拟器能预测到你会从第21位升到第2位，或者5圈内提升14个位置。”
“没有任何模拟器能做到这一点。所以，马克斯经常超越模拟结果。”
当领先集团在第16圈末进站将半雨胎换成干胎时，维斯塔潘位列第五，尽管此后他的小红牛22平衡感已不再相同。
据这位四届世界冠军所说，这不仅仅是干胎对赛车平衡可能造成的影响，因为小红牛22在最后几圈——再次用半雨胎完成——的感觉也与开场阶段大不相同。
红牛车队在比赛中已经承认，他们可以从数据中看到尾部下压力的损失，尽管梅基斯表示还需要进一步调查才能确定具体原因。
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，奥利弗·贝尔曼，哈斯F1车队
今年早些时候，维斯塔潘曾不止一次抱怨“赛车性能衰退”，这也是为什么这位四届世界冠军在爬出赛车后立即查看车尾，看看是否有任何可见的损伤。
“你们可能已经听到，当我们在换上干胎后，马克斯对赛车平衡性表达了相当多的意见，”梅基斯承认道。
从那一刻起，他对赛车平衡一直非常非常不满意，包括我们最后换回半雨胎的时候。所以我们需要分析那里发生了什么，其中有多少能解释我们的时间损失，以及那是否足以与迈凯伦竞争。
与迈凯伦在车队积分榜上的争夺
尽管如此，红牛在车队积分榜上仍然取得了不错的成绩。周六在圣保罗的荷兰媒体环节中，维斯塔潘已经明确表示，车手积分榜第二名对他毫无意义，但他对今年剩余比赛有一个明确目标：帮助红牛锁定车队积分榜第三名。
由于兰多·诺里斯获得杆位而维斯塔潘从后排发车，巴西的正赛日原本可能很痛苦，但红牛最终以与迈凯伦相同的积分（33分）结束了这个周末。
除了维斯塔潘的逆转驾驶之外，这也得益于伊萨克·哈贾尔的非常强劲表现，这意味着红牛仍然对安德烈亚·斯特拉领导的团队保持17分的优势。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队
尽管维斯塔潘在英特拉格斯的逆转驾驶如今已成为某种传统，但他已经表示希望打破这一传统。在新闻发布会上，这位荷兰人呼吁红牛明年在巴西避免发车位处罚，尽管梅基斯解释说，原计划本来就是在刚过去的周末不出现发车位下降的情况下完成比赛。
在媒体日期间，红牛暗示希望尽可能推迟不可避免的动力单元更换——也许推迟到拉斯维加斯——但在周五的各节练习与排位之后，车队别无选择。
“当然，这很令人沮丧，因为周五的速度看起来不错，周六早上也是，在某些方面Q1我们让他参加排位赛时也是如此。但这就是比赛的一部分，你明白吗？”梅基斯说道。
“人们很容易忘记，这是我们使用自己动力单元的第一年。伙计们一直做得非常出色，我们直到这个周末才和马克斯第一次受到处罚，事情就是这样。这并不在计划之中，但周五我们遇到了一个小问题，迫使我们这么做。但事情就是这样。”
detailEn: How Max Verstappen beat Red Bull's own simulation tools with P2 in Brazil
Team principal Laurent Mekies admits that Red Bull's simulation tools did not consider second place possible from 21st on the grid

For the third year in a row, Verstappen produced an impressive comeback drive in the Formula 1 Sao Paulo Grand Prix. While the Dutchman won from 17th on the grid in 2024 and climbed from the pitlane to third place last year, this time he charged from 21st to second.

According to Verstappen, his start on the uphill grid did not go to plan, although he took the blame himself after holding the clutch incorrectly, resulting in a slower reaction time. After that, however, the Dutchman made rapid progress. During his first stint on intermediates, he already had the podium positions in his sights, much sooner than Red Bull had ever expected based on its own simulations.
"As always, I think no sim in the world will predict that you will go from P21 to P2 or that you get 14 places in 5 laps," Laurent Mekies said post-race in Red Bull’s hospitality unit.
"There is no sim able to do that. So, Max is beating the simulations on a regular basis."

When the first frontrunners came into the pits at the end of lap 16 to swap their intermediates for slicks, Verstappen was running fifth, although the balance of his RB22 no longer felt the same afterwards.

According to the four-time world champion, this was not simply down to the effect slick tyres might have had on the car balance, as the RB22 also felt very different from the opening stages during the closing laps, which were once again completed on intermediates.
Red Bull had already acknowledged during the race that it could see a loss of rear downforce in the data, although Mekies says further investigation is needed to establish exactly what caused it.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Oliver Bearman, Haas F1 Team

Earlier this year, Verstappen complained more than once about 'car degradation', which is why the four-time world champion also took a look at the rear of his car immediately after climbing out to see whether there was any visible damage.
"You may have heard Max being fairly vocal with the car balance once we had switched to dry tyres," Mekies admitted.

"From that point onwards, he has been very, very unhappy with the car balance, including when we came back to the inters at the very end. So we’ll need to analyse what happened there, how much of that is explaining our time loss and whether or not that would have been enough to fight with McLaren."
The battle with McLaren in the constructors' championship

Nevertheless, Red Bull has still done good business in the constructors' championship. During Saturday's Dutch media session in Sao Paulo, Verstappen had already made it clear that finishing second in the drivers' championship means nothing to him, but that he has a clear objective for the remaining races of this year: helping Red Bull secure third place in the constructors' standings.

With Lando Norris on pole position and Verstappen on the back row of the grid, race day in Brazil could have been a painful one, but Red Bull ultimately ended the weekend with the same number of points as McLaren (33).
As well as Verstappen's comeback drive, this was also down to a very strong performance from Isack Hadjar, meaning Red Bull still holds a 17-point advantage over the team led by Andrea Stella.
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing

Although Verstappen's comeback drives at Interlagos have now become something of a tradition, he has already indicated that he would like to break that tradition. During the press conference, the Dutchman called on Red Bull to avoid a grid penalty in Brazil for once next year, although Mekies explained that the plan had actually been to complete the past weekend without a grid drop in the first place.

During the media day, Red Bull hinted that it wanted to postpone the inevitable power unit change for as long as possible – perhaps until Las Vegas – but after Friday's practice sessions, the team had no choice.

"Of course, it's frustrating because the pace seemed good on Friday and also on Saturday morning, and in some respects also in Q1 when we let him qualify. But it's part of the game, you know?" Mekies said.

"It's easy to forget that this is the first year with our own power unit. The guys have been doing an extraordinary job, we only took our first penalty with Max this weekend and that's what it is. It was not planned, but we had a small issue on Friday that forced us to do so. But that's what it is."

detailZh: 梅赛德斯老板沃尔夫拥有九个车队冠军
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
在圣保罗周日晚间被问及自己的纪录时，托托·沃尔夫无需自夸，这些纪录如今让他与F1两位伟人比肩。仅是被问到追平弗兰克·威廉姆斯的车队冠军数和罗恩·丹尼斯的总体冠军数感受如何，就足以说明沃尔夫成就的分量。
他现有九个车队冠军，与威廉姆斯持平，总体冠军数为17个，与丹尼斯持平。
“当我想到这一点时，这两位是这项运动的巨人，”他说。“我甚至不在弗兰克所在的同一星系里，他在事故之后仍然能够取得伟大成就。同样，罗恩是一个你总是仰望的人，他是这项运动的标杆，设定了新的标准。”
他补充道：“我永远不会把自己看作那个级别的人。”
自从那两位赢得冠军并试图击败彼此的时代以来，一级方程式已经发生了巨大变化。这也许过于简化，但如今更重要的是经营一门高效的生意，而不是经营最好的车库。他们同样必须确保赞助协议并吸引最优秀的人才，但现代F1的运营，尤其是一支拥有自己引擎部门的厂商车队，要复杂许多倍。员工人数的巨大差异令人震惊。
沃尔夫没有机会认识为他车队工作的每一个人，也无法依赖那种在1980年代或许仍然可能的微观管理。这需要不同的技能组合，需要对所谓的“文化”有更清晰的理解，并且在构建一个组织时要有更高的精确度，在这个组织中，授权不仅是一种工具，而且是一种必需。
但丹尼斯和威廉姆斯两人的共同之处在于，他们并非只是在车队表现的巅峰、一切条件都契合时连续夺冠。他们反复做到这一点，重建自己所领导的团队，然后再次回归并夺冠。威廉姆斯在与本田分手后做到了这一点，凭借雷诺重返巅峰。丹尼斯则在阿兰·普罗斯特和艾尔顿·塞纳时代之后做到了这一点，重建迈凯伦，与米卡·哈基宁和梅赛德斯一起赢得三个冠军。
沃尔夫大概说得没错，从某种意义上说，他从未需要应对涉及主要合作伙伴或引擎制造商变更的彻底重组。但2026赛季最终证明，他也并非只能成功一次的人。
梅赛德斯并没有跌到谷底。但在如此轻松且持续地获胜之后，车队可能变得过于固守旧法，难以改变和适应。2022年的新规则周期是一场压力测试，它未能通过——而在追赶方面，旧方法已不再奏效。
我们永远不会确切知道沃尔夫做了什么，或者哪些流程需要改变。我们只能根据结果来判断。而2026年证实了他做了必须做的事。
“回头看，我觉得那最后四年非常艰难，”他在周日说道。“在犯错、然后有点明白为什么错、接着意识到不，我们没搞懂之间……那是一个很大的反复。”
“但我们在10年或20年后回看，当你看看统计数据，那四年我们并不是彻底的失败者，因为我们拿了第二、第三、第三、第四——我想那大概就是当时的结果。我们赢过比赛，赢过很多比赛。所以单看数字，那根本不差，但感觉并不好。”
“而车队的韧性，那些在艰难时期团结在一起的人，是一个因素，我认为。所以锁定这两个冠军感觉真的很好。”
“没有多少运动队能在连续夺冠、然后经历一段艰难时期、再重新回来之后做到这一点。所以我真的很自豪，我们属于在所有体育项目中做到这一点的极少数车队之一。”
即便他目前还不在同一水平线上，他也无疑是F1历史上最优秀的车队领队之一。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯；安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯；托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
文化这个词常被管理者使用和滥用，其中许多人并不真正理解它的含义。但这不仅仅是原则和规则的问题。它关乎选择一个共同目标，建立正确的流程，找到最优秀的人并帮助他们实现抱负——并为此全力以赴。
有很多人声称要建设“一种文化”。真正理解自己所指为何的人却少得多。
“我们不是一个随意招聘和解雇的组织，”沃尔夫说。“我们提供一种文化与环境，让你能够茁壮成长，允许你犯错，允许你直言不讳。从长远来看，我相信，如果你想取得成功——不是几年内的成功，而是几十年间的成功——这就是你需要能够根植于团队的东西。”
“我们正在努力这样做。这不是你能放在幻灯片上的东西。你必须日复一日地提升自己的标准。而这些就是我们为自己设定的标准。有时我们会失败，但我们着眼于长期愿景。”
同样，只看到冰山一角不足以准确判断这其中有多少是沃尔夫的功劳。但这种帮助人们茁壮成长的文化——这也意味着支持那些正在挣扎的人——是显而易见的。
沃尔夫处理乔治·拉塞尔的方式，或许也是梅赛德斯F1车队中周日唯一不完全满意的人，同样是管理人才的教科书式范例。
对拉塞尔来说，这一年无疑很艰难。但沃尔夫始终把手搭在他肩上，从不让外界有任何理由怀疑自己仍然信任他——尽管有些人认为沃尔夫只关心安东内利。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
“今天属于乔治的冠军，”托托说。“这是车队冠军，而他是车队的一部分，我真的很高兴他能珍惜这一刻，因为我们欠他的。”
他还补充道：“我对明年毫无疑问，所有最优秀的体育人都经历过困难时期，这将是他持续成长的一部分。”
听听乔治自己怎么说。他的圣保罗周末或许完美诠释了他的2026赛季。速度的闪光，但不受他控制的环境因素阻止他取得成绩——就像周六发生的那样——以及他自己的一些失误，比如周日维修区出口的那次。
但他谈论沃尔夫的方式几乎让人毫不怀疑他也感受到了那份信任。
周六，当2026赛季以错失杆位的形式再次给他打击时，他谈论更多的仍是更大的图景而非事件本身：“我认为托托领导力中我很钦佩的一点是，我们今天拥有的人，正是那些辉煌岁月里就在的人，也正是那些经历了2022到2025年困难时期的人。
“没有人被聘用又被解雇。信任和信念始终与核心团队同在，而且，你知道，现在我们挺过来了。而且，你知道，显然，基米赢得了冠军。我们会赢得冠军，无论是这个周末还是下一个。而且，你知道，要归功于团队中的每一个人，但是的，托托对人们的忠诚和信念，即使在艰难时期也如此，这要大大归功于他。”
这种忠诚与信任，正是沃尔夫此刻向拉塞尔展示的。而拉塞尔的职业生涯仍可能走上两条截然不同的道路：一条是尼科·罗斯伯格的路，另一条是丹尼尔·里卡多的路。
里卡多当年觉得，当他认为车队把所有希望都押在马克斯·维斯塔潘身上时，自己除了离开红牛别无选择。但在沃尔夫执掌梅赛德斯的情况下，拉塞尔仍然知道自己有机会实现目标——这要归功于他的老板在车队中建立的文化。
因为这是一种允许人们学习、重建并再次获胜的文化。
此外也没有太多可补充的了。数据本身就说明了一切。
向托托·沃尔夫致敬。那件事处理得很好。
detailEn: Nine constructors' titles for the Mercedes boss
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes

Toto Wolff didn't need to brag when, on Sunday evening in Sao Paulo, he was asked about his records, which now put him alongside two of F1's greats. The question of how it feels to match Frank Williams' tally of constructors' championships and Ron Dennis' overall number of titles was enough in itself to illustrate the magnitude of Wolff's achievements.
He now has nine constructors' titles, level with Williams, and 17 titles overall, matching Dennis.

"When I think about it, these two are giants of the sport," he said. "I'm not even operating in the same galaxy as Frank, who after his accident, has been able to achieve great things. And in the same way, Ron is a person that [you] always look up to who has been the benchmark in the sport, who has set new standards."
He added: "I will never see myself in that league."

Formula 1 has changed enormously since the days when those two were winning titles and trying to beat each other. It might be an oversimplification, but nowadays it's much more about running an efficient business than running the best garage. They, too, had to secure sponsorship deals and attract the best talent, but modern F1 operations, especially a works team with its own engine department, are many times more complex. The sheer difference in employee numbers is staggering.

Wolff has no chance of knowing everyone working for his team and can't rely on the kind of micromanagement that was perhaps still possible in the 1980s. It requires a different skill set, a much clearer understanding of what's called "culture", and far greater precision in building an organisation in which delegation is not just a tool, but a necessity.

But what Dennis and Williams have in common is that they didn't just win titles in succession, at the peak of their teams' performance, when everything aligned. They did it repeatedly, rebuilding the organisations they led to come back and win again. Williams did it after splitting with Honda, returning to the top with Renault. Dennis did it after the Alain Prost and Ayrton Senna era, rebuilding McLaren to win three titles with Mika Hakkinen and Mercedes.

Wolff is probably right in the sense that he has never had to deal with a complete reorganisation involving a change of major partners or engine manufacturer. But the 2026 season is the ultimate proof that he, too, is not someone who can only do it once.

Mercedes didn't hit rock bottom. But after winning so easily and so consistently, the team may have become too set in its ways to change and adapt. The new regulation cycle in 2022 was a stress test it failed – and the old methods were no longer working when it came to catching up.
We'll never know exactly what Wolff did or which processes needed to change. We can only judge by the results. And 2026 is confirmation that he did what was required.

"Looking back, I think those last four years were very difficult," he said on Sunday. "Between getting it wrong and then kind of understanding why it was wrong and then realising, no, we didn't understand... And that was a big back and forth.

"But we will be looking back in 10 or 20 years, and when you look at the statistics, it wasn't that we were complete losers over those four years, because we finished second, third, third, fourth - I think that was maybe what the results were. We won races, won many races. So it wasn't that bad at all when you look at the sheer numbers, but it felt not good.
"And the resilience of the team, the people that held together in those tough times is a factor, I think. So it feels really good sealing those two titles.

"Not many sports teams have done that after a consecutive run of championships, then a difficult spell, and then coming back. So I'm really proud that we are part of this very small group of teams that have done that in all sports."
Even if he isn't in quite the same league yet, he's certainly among the very best team bosses in F1 history.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes

Culture is a word often used and abused by managers, many of whom don't really understand what it entails. But it's not just a matter of principles and rules. It's about choosing a common goal, putting the right processes in place, finding the best people and helping them fulfil their ambitions – and being committed to all of it.
There are plenty of people who say they want to build "a culture". Far fewer actually understand what they mean by that.

"We are not a hire-and-fire organisation," Wolff says. "We provide a culture and an environment where you can thrive, where you are allowed to make mistakes, where you can speak up. And over the long term, I believe, if you want to be successful, not over a period of a few years but over many decades, this is what you need to be able to kind of ingrain in the team.

"And we are trying that. It's not something you put on a PowerPoint. You have to lift your standards day in and day out. And these are the standards we are setting to ourselves. Sometimes we fail, but we look at the long-term vision."

Again, seeing only the tip of the iceberg isn't enough to judge exactly how much of this is Wolff's doing. But that culture of helping people thrive – which also means supporting those who are struggling – is on display.
The way Wolff handles George Russell, probably the only member of the Mercedes F1 team who wasn't entirely happy on Sunday, is a textbook example of managing talent, too.

It's been a tough year for Russell, no doubt about that. But Wolff keeps an arm around his shoulder and never gives the outside world any reason to doubt that he still believes in him – even though some suggest he only cares about Antonelli.
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes
"It's George's championship today," Toto said. "It's the constructors' championship, and he's part of the team, and I'm really happy that he can cherish this moment, because we owe it to him."
And he added: "I have no doubt about that for next year, and all the very best sports people have gone through difficult periods, and that's going to be part of his continued development."

And listen to George himself. His Sao Paulo weekend was perhaps a perfect illustration of his 2026 season. Flashes of speed, but circumstances beyond his control preventing him from getting the result – as happened on Saturday – and some mistakes of his own, as at the pit exit on Sunday.
But the way he speaks about Wolff leaves little doubt that he feels that trust, too.

On Saturday, when 2026 dealt him another blow in the form of a missed pole position, he still spoke more about the bigger picture than the incident itself: "I think something I admire a lot from Toto's leadership is the people we have today are the same people who were there during the glory years, and they're the same people who went through the difficulties during 2022 to 2025.

"Nobody was hired and fired. The trust and belief stayed with the core group of people, and, you know, now we've come through. And, you know, obviously, Kimi won the championship. We are going to win the championship, whether it's this weekend or next. And, you know, credit to everybody in the team, but yeah, huge credit to Toto for that loyalty and belief in the people, even when times were tough."
That loyalty and belief is exactly what Wolff is showing Russell right now. And Russell's career could still follow one of two very different paths: that of Nico Rosberg or that of Daniel Ricciardo.

Ricciardo felt he had little choice but to leave Red Bull when he believed the team was putting all its eggs in the Max Verstappen basket. But with Wolff leading Mercedes, Russell still knows he has a chance to achieve what he wants – thanks to the culture his boss has built at the team.
Because it's a culture that allows people to learn, rebuild and win again.
And there's not much more to add. The statistics really speak for themselves.
Hats off, Toto Wolff. That was well managed.

detailZh: 谁昨晚睡得最糟糕：费尔南多·阿隆索
在圣保罗周六表现出色之后，汽车又一次让阿隆索失望了
当费尔南多·阿隆索在2005年成为一级方程式世界冠军时，他只有24岁，取代了埃默森·菲蒂帕尔迪，成为赛车历史上最年轻的世界冠军。最后，迈克尔·舒马赫终于有了挑战者。尽管这位F1的统治者在一次误称这位年轻的西班牙公牛为"Ferdinando"时，因为他几乎记不起他的名字，但最终是阿隆索结束了舒马赫的黄金时代。
2001年的新秀班非常出色：阿隆索、胡安·帕布洛·蒙托亚、基米·莱科宁。巴西的恩里克·贝尔纳尔迪也参加了墨尔本赛季揭幕战，马来西亚的亚历克斯·杨和捷克车手托马斯·恩格后来加入了该赛季。这些名字在很大程度上已经消失在人们的视野中。但至少有50%的2001级学生后来取得了辉煌的成就。

一级方程式赛车在那时是一个完全不同的世界。车队老板是像罗恩·邓恩、弗朗克·威廉姆斯、爱迪·乔丹和汤姆·沃金肖这样的男人。如今的世界冠军梅赛德斯车队当时被称为BAR，红牛还是捷豹，阿兰·普罗斯的车队则运行着重新贴上电脑品牌宏碁标志的法拉利引擎。Facebook和Instagram还不存在，穿着比基尼和紧身短裤的网格女孩随意举着车手的号码，网格上仍然有像让-阿莱西和约斯·维斯塔潘这样的老将，以及马克斯·维斯塔潘的父亲。
任何当时预测阿隆索25年后仍将是一级方程式赛车中最优秀的车手之一，但永远不会赢得超过两个世界冠军的人，可能会被像默里·沃克或海因茨·普鲁勒这样的记者嘲笑为疯子。
我曾经在一家养老院服过兵役，每次我告诉我妈妈我的工作时，她都会说："当人们变老时，他们又变成了孩子。"在某种程度上，这也适用于费尔南多·阿隆索。
2001年，他首次在一级方程式赛车中亮相，加入了明ини车队。澳大利亚航空公司企业家保罗·斯托达特买下了我们现在知道的红牛车队，阿隆索在一个17场比赛的季节中获得了零分，没有一级方程式短跑，并在10月14日在铃鹿的锦标赛决赛中。不是因为他的巨大才华已经不明显，而是因为机械根本无法胜任这项工作。
现在，作为一级方程式的资深人士，阿隆索发现自己处于与当年作为大奖赛新生儿时完全相同的情况：他的队友根本无法与他抗衡，没有人对他的驾驶能力表示怀疑，然而他却因为自己的赛车性能无法提升而绝望地被困在车队后方。
在这期间，他已经赢得了两个世界锦标赛、32个大奖赛胜利以及25年的生活经验。令人惊讶的是，几乎没有变化：阿隆索的速度超过了他的赛车。在24个比赛周末中的20个，他只获得了7分。只有2001年，在明尼迪车队，他的得分更少。
然而，在2005年他首次赢得世界冠军的地点——伊纳波利斯赛道，证明了阿隆索并没有失去从一级方程式赛车中榨取每一丝秒的能力。
当雨来临时，为那些驾驶竞争力较弱的赛车的车手打开了克服赛车不足的大门，阿隆索的出色表现显露无遗。在周六的排位赛中，他多次短暂地领跑，最终确保了本赛季首次进入Q3的资格。
在周日的比赛中，他甚至有时能与法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿等车手一较高下。赛后，阿隆索表示，阿斯顿·马丁在湿滑的赛道上的表现必须是非凡的（诚然，本田引擎的表现则相对较差）。
也许吧。但问题是：只有在阿隆索手中，阿斯顿·马丁才表现得非凡。
周六，阿隆索展示了为什么他45岁仍然属于一级方程式。周日，阿斯顿·马丁则向他展示了为什么45岁的他可能更适合做其他事情。结果是第12名，没有积分。又一个周末，阿隆索证明了他车技超群，不适合他的赛车。
这一切应该足以抚慰他的自尊心，帮助他夜间睡得香甜。但无论阿隆索如何努力，无论有多少人怀疑他的能力，他第三次成为世界冠军并最终为这个在过去二十年里变成永无止境故事的童话故事画上圆满句号的几率都很小。
在一级方程式赛车中，很少有车手像他这样，在多年里为今天的大部分顶级车队参赛，或者至少在某些时候与他们有过交谈。在法拉利，他几乎触手可及地接近第三个世界冠军，但最终并未实现。在迈凯轮，他留下了烧焦的土地。两次。
他与红牛的谈话在2007年最为严肃，至少赫尔穆特·马克告诉我的是这样。红牛有阿德里安·纽维，但阿隆索似乎缺乏迪特里希·马特希茨大胆愿景的信心，即挑战既定车队和制造商的愿景能够成为现实。到红牛在2009年开始向一个非凡成功的时代迈进时，阿隆索已经在为转投法拉利做准备。
讽刺的是，几乎20年后，阿隆索现在将再次成为世界冠军的希望寄托在阿斯顿·马丁的阿德里安·纽维身上。这位多年前他似乎低估了在红牛潜力的设计师。这应该会是他长期承诺的传记中的精彩材料，我在2021年7月在亚马逊上预定了这本书，但时至今日，它仍未出版。
在2016年底，他在麦克拉伦-本田的漫长职业生涯中处于最低谷的时候，当他已经开始从心理上从一级方程式赛车中抽身时，当时的现世界冠军尼科·罗斯伯格突然宣布退役。就在那天晚上，在FIA颁奖典礼上，弗拉维奥·布里atore打电话给梅赛德斯车队负责人托托·沃尔夫，试图为阿隆索争取罗斯伯格空出的座位。但阿隆索在麦克拉伦-梅赛德斯车队期间烧毁了许多桥梁，戴姆勒首席执行官迪特·蔡舍并没有忘记"间谍门"。
有时阿隆索打开了错误的门。有时门被猛地关在他的脸上。有时他自己把门关得太用力，以至于多年后，门再也无法打开。
当阿隆索于2023年加入阿斯顿·马丁车队并在首个赛季立刻获得八个领奖台位置时，似乎他终于摆脱了坏运气的诅咒。今天，三年后，我们知道情况并非如此。如果他离开后车队多年后最终取得成功，这也不会让人感到惊讶。就像麦凯轮车队一样。
阿隆索并不总是不幸情况的受害者。有些门是他自己关上的。有些桥梁是他亲手烧毁的。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，麦凯轮车队，费尔南多·阿隆索，麦凯轮车队
阿隆索并不是一个容易失眠的人。他经历过太多，取得过太多，向我们证明过太多，以至于仅仅因为他将永远无法在本生中获得第三个世界冠军而感到沮丧。然而，他的故事中却有着深深的遗憾。如果他像维特尔或汉密尔顿那样幸运，在正确的时间和地点找到了自己的位置，他现在可能已经拥有五次或更多的世界冠军头衔了。但他没有。
回到2001年，当阿隆索刚开始参加一级方程式赛车时，我读到的报纸文章总会不自觉地描述伟大的斯图尔特·莫斯爵士为从未赢得过世界冠军的最优秀的大奖赛车手。
也许在遥远的未来某个时刻，他们会将费尔南多·阿隆索描述为赢得过“仅仅”两次世界冠军的最优秀的大奖赛车手。
尽管如此，事情本可以更糟。
detailEn: Who slept worst last night: Fernando Alonso
Another case of the car letting Alonso down after a stellar Sao Paulo Saturday

When Fernando Alonso became Formula 1 world champion in 2005, he was just 24 years old, replacing Emerson Fittipaldi as the youngest champion in the sport's history. At last, Michael Schumacher had a challenger. And although the reigning king of F1 once mistakenly called the young Spanish bull "Ferdinando" because he couldn't quite remember his name, it was Alonso who ultimately brought Schumacher's golden era to an end.

The rookie class of 2001 was an exceptional one: Alonso, Juan Pablo Montoya, Kimi Raikkonen. Brazilian Enrique Bernoldi was also on the grid for the season opener in Melbourne, with Malaysia's Alex Yoong and Czech driver Tomas Enge joining later in the year. Names that have largely faded into obscurity. But at least 50 per cent of the class of 2001 went on to greatness.

Formula 1 was a very different world back then. Team bosses were men like Ron Dennis, Frank Williams, Eddie Jordan and Tom Walkinshaw. Today's world championship-winning Mercedes team was called BAR, Red Bull was still Jaguar, and Alain Prost's team ran a Ferrari engine rebadged in the name of the computer brand Acer. Facebook and Instagram didn't exist, grid girls in bikinis and skin-tight shorts casually held up the drivers' numbers, and the grid still featured old warhorses like Jean Alesi and Jos Verstappen, Max's father.

Anyone who had predicted back then that Alonso would still be among Formula 1's best drivers 25 years later, yet would never win more than two world championships, would probably have been dismissed as a lunatic by journalists such as Murray Walker or Heinz Prüller.

I once did my civilian service in a retirement home, and whenever I told my mother about my work, she would say: "When people get old, they become like children again." In a way, that applies to Fernando Alonso, too.

In 2001, he made his Formula 1 debut with Minardi. Australian airline entrepreneur Paul Stoddart had bought the team we now know as Racing Bulls, and Alonso scored precisely zero points in a 17-race season, with no F1 Sprints and a championship finale at Suzuka on 14 October. Not because his considerable talent wasn't already obvious, but because the machinery simply wasn't up to the job.

Now, as F1's elder statesman, Alonso finds himself in exactly the same situation as when he was a Grand Prix baby: his team-mate doesn't stand a chance against him, nobody seriously questions his ability behind the wheel, and yet he is hopelessly stuck towards the back because his car simply cannot deliver.

In between, there have been two world championships, 32 Grand Prix victories and a quarter of a century of life experience. Remarkably little has changed: Alonso is faster than his car. After 20 of 24 race weekends, he has just seven points to his name. Only in 2001, with Minardi, did he score fewer.

And yet Interlagos, the very place where he clinched his first world title in 2005, provided proof that Alonso has lost none of his ability to extract every last fraction of a second from a Formula 1 car.

When the rain arrived, opening the door for drivers in less competitive machinery to overcome their cars' shortcomings, Alonso's class shone through. During Saturday's qualifying session, he briefly topped the timesheets on several occasions, eventually securing his first Q3 appearance of the season.

In Sunday's race, he even found himself mixing it with the likes of Lewis Hamilton in the Ferrari at times. Afterwards, Alonso suggested that the Aston Martin must have been "phenomenal" in the corners on a wet track (the Honda engine, admittedly, rather less so).
Perhaps. But here's the thing: it was only phenomenal in Alonso's hands.

On Saturday, Alonso showed why he still belongs in Formula 1 at 45. On Sunday, Aston Martin showed him why, at 45, he might be better off doing something else. The result was 12th place. No points. Another weekend in which Alonso proved he is too good for his car.

All of which should be enough to stroke his ego and help him sleep soundly at night. But however hard Alonso tries, and however little anyone doubts his ability, the chances of him becoming world champion for a third time and finally writing a happy ending to a fairy tale that has turned into a never-ending story over the past two decades are slim.

There are few drivers in Formula 1 who, over the years, have raced for so many of today's top teams, or at least held talks with them at some point. At Ferrari, he came agonisingly close to a third title, but it never quite happened. At McLaren, he left scorched earth behind him. Twice.

His talks with Red Bull were at their most serious in 2007, or at least that's what Helmut Marko once told me. Red Bull had Adrian Newey, but Alonso apparently lacked the confidence that Dietrich Mateschitz's bold vision of taking on the established teams and manufacturers could actually become reality. By the time Red Bull began its rise towards an era of extraordinary success in 2009, Alonso was already preparing to move to Ferrari.

The irony? Almost 20 years later, Alonso is now pinning his hopes of becoming world champion again on none other than Adrian Newey at Aston Martin. The very designer whose potential at Red Bull he apparently underestimated all those years ago. It should make for fascinating material in his long-promised autobiography, which I pre-ordered on Amazon in July 2021 and which, to this day, has still not been published.

In late 2016, during one of the lowest periods of his long career at McLaren-Honda, when he had already begun to mentally move on from Formula 1, reigning world champion Nico Rosberg suddenly announced his retirement. That very evening, at the FIA prize-giving gala, Flavio Briatore called Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff in an attempt to secure Rosberg's vacant seat for Alonso. But Alonso had burned too many bridges during his time at McLaren-Mercedes, and Daimler CEO Dieter Zetsche had not forgotten "Spygate".
Sometimes Alonso opened the wrong door. Sometimes it was slammed in his face. And sometimes he had slammed it so hard himself that, years later, it could no longer be opened.

When Alonso joined Aston Martin in 2023 and immediately scored eight podium finishes in his first season, it seemed he had finally shaken off the curse of bad timing. Today, three years later, we know better. And it would hardly be surprising if the team eventually became successful years after his departure. Just as McLaren did.
Alonso wasn't always simply the victim of unfortunate circumstances. Some doors he closed himself. Some bridges he burned with his own hands.
Lewis Hamilton, McLaren, Fernando Alonso, McLaren

Alonso isn't someone who loses sleep easily. He has experienced too much, achieved too much and proved too much to all of us to get worked up simply because he will never win a third world championship in this lifetime. And yet there is something deeply regrettable about his story. Had he been as fortunate as Vettel or Hamilton in finding himself in the right place at the right time, he could probably have five or more world championships to his name by now. But he doesn't.

Back in 2001, when Alonso was starting out in Formula 1, the newspaper articles I read would invariably describe the great Sir Stirling Moss as the finest Grand Prix driver never to have won a world championship.
Perhaps, at some point in the distant future, they will write about Fernando Alonso as the finest Grand Prix driver ever to have won "only" two world championships.
Still, things could be worse.

items.titleZh: 皮亚斯蒂与韦伯的F1管理团队分手
items.summaryZh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂与由前F1车手马克·韦伯和安·尼尔领导的管理团队分道扬镳。
items.originalTitle: Piastri splits with Webber's F1 management team
detailZh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂与由前F1车手马克·韦伯和安·尼尔领导的管理团队分道扬镳。
代表麦凯轮车手皮亚斯蒂的声明在周一巴西大奖赛之后宣布，双方已达成协议结束合作。
九次大奖赛冠军韦伯自2019年开始与皮亚斯蒂合作，在年轻的澳大利亚人进入F1之前，他的事业开始起飞。
皮亚斯蒂表示他们的"指导是无价的，尤其是在我F1生涯的初期"。
当皮亚斯特里在2020年和2021年连续赢得三级方程式和二级方程式的冠军时，但当时的赞助商阿尔卑斯未能让他进入2022年的赛车网格，这时韦伯实质性地改变了皮亚斯特里的近期未来，使其变得更好。
阿尔卑斯模糊地试图留住皮亚斯特里更长时间，并热衷于将他借调到威廉姆斯车队，度过几个赛季，但韦伯并没有接受这个提议。
知道阿尔卑斯在处理皮亚斯特里的一级方程式合同方面出了差错，因此有机会离开，韦伯推动皮亚斯特里在2023年取代丹尼尔·里卡多加入麦克拉伦，这一举动震惊了阿尔卑斯和一级方程式车手圈。
这使他从边缘位置脱颖而出，跳过了中等赛季，在末流车队或中游车队的表现，并在他的新秀赛季成为一级方程式领奖台的完赛者。
皮亚斯特里在2024年迎来了他的首次胜利，并在2025年险些赢得世界冠军。去年三月，皮亚斯特里的管理团队为他签订了一份新的多年合约——韦伯在今年夏天表示，皮亚斯特里对这份合约仍然满意，尽管有关麦凯轮与马克斯·维斯塔潘转会传闻，以及皮亚斯特里可能想要离开的猜测。
然而，今年，皮亚斯特里和韦伯的安排发生了变化。韦伯之前是皮亚斯特里在赛道边的常客，而今年，韦伯/尼尔的角色被移到了幕后”，皮亚斯特里在赛季前的测试中这样说道。
在上个赛季，皮亚斯特里在几次比赛中遭遇了不公平的待遇，因为麦凯轮试图在皮亚斯特里和他的队友兰多·诺里斯之间平衡冠军争夺战，韦伯对麦凯轮的行为以及皮亚斯特里在赛季最后四分之一中遭遇的冠军破坏性下滑时的解释并不满意。
麦凯轮和皮亚斯特里阵营之间是否真的存在任何严重的紧张关系——除了赛车团队和特定车手支持团体之间典型的利益冲突之外——双方从未直接回应过。
皮亚斯特里将2026年的转变描述为“只是稍微退后一步，仅此而已”，但现在这种关系已经结束了。
“在本赛季减少赛道旁参与之后，我们一致认为现在是结束我们的管理协议的合适时机，”Webber说。
“这将允许Oscar在新的管理结构下继续他的成就，并让我们开始我们的新冒险。”
“我们祝愿Oscar拥有漫长而成功的事业。”
detailEn: Oscar Piastri has split from the management team headed by ex-Formula 1 driver Mark Webber and Ann Neal.
A statement on behalf of McLaren driver Piastri announced on Monday after the Brazilian Grand Prix that the two parties had mutually ended their agreement.
Nine-time grand prix winner Webber started working with Piastri in 2019, before the young Australian's ascent to F1 really gathered momentum.
Piastri said their "guidance has been invaluable, particularly in navigating the beginning of my F1 career".

It was when Piastri won back-to-back titles in Formula 3 and Formula 2 in 2020 and 2021, but then-backer Alpine failed to get him onto the grid in 2022, that Webber substantially changed Piastri's immediate future for the better.
Alpine vaguely tried to hang on to Piastri longer-term and was keen to place him in a Williams seat on loan for a couple of seasons, which Webber did not accept.

Knowing Alpine had bungled the handling of Piastri's F1 contract, so there was a window to leave, Webber pushed for the McLaren switch for 2023 in place of Daniel Ricciardo that stunned Alpine and the F1 paddock.
It pulled Piastri from the sidelines, vaulted him clear of middling seasons in a backmarker or midfield team, and made him an F1 podium finisher in his rookie season.

Piastri's first wins followed in 2024, and he narrowly missed out on winning the world championship in 2025. In March last year, Piastri's management secured him a new multi-year deal - which Webber said this summer Piastri was still happy with as speculation linked McLaren with a Max Verstappen move, and there were suggestions Piastri may want to leave anyway.

This year, though, the Piastri-Webber arrangement shifted. Webber was previously a regular presence in the paddock alongside Piastri whereas this year the Webber/Neal role was moved "behind the scenes", Piastri said back in pre-season testing.

Last season, when Piastri got the rough end of the stick on several occasions with how McLaren tried to balance the title fight between him and team-mate Lando Norris, Webber was not impressed by McLaren's actions, nor the reasoning given when Piastri had a championship-wrecking slump in the final quarter of the year.

Whether there was any serious tension between McLaren and Piastri's camp - beyond typical clashes of interest between a race team and the group supporting one driver specifically - has never been directly addressed by either party.
Piastri described the 2026 shift as "just taking a bit of a step back, that's all", but now the relationship has ended.
"Following our reduced trackside involvement this season, we have collectively agreed that now is an appropriate time to bring our management agreement to a close," said Webber.
"This will allow Oscar to build on his achievements under a new management structure, and for us to embark on our new ventures.
"We wish Oscar all the very best for a long and successful career."
